summary: PushBits is a self-hosted notification server designed to relay push messages through Matrix. It functions similarly to alternatives like PushBullet and Gotify, allowing you to centralise and route notifications from various services.
goodFor: This tool is a good fit if you already rely on Matrix for communication and want to route self-hosted application alerts directly into your existing chat infrastructure.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity and a low repository star count, meaning you might have to patch bugs yourself or deal with unaddressed security issues.
deployNotes: Written in Go, it typically compiles into a single static binary that requires a reverse proxy for TLS termination and persistent storage for configuration data.
